ai_model.note: One get_completion call does two jobs: individual-vs-service classification and naming the individuals from the message text. Both are squarely Standard's recommended workload (1x tasks vs 3x advanced / 5x premium); the name pass added no step and no extra task. Verified offline via run-action harness with the deployed prompt + output fields, identical across two consecutive runs: classification 10/10 unchanged after the name pass was added, and the name cases correct — including the one that matters, holding a mailbox-shaped guess (john.smith@ -> 'John Smith') at 'low' so it is discarded, and inventing no names for addresses absent from the context. Cases tables in README. The Worker this replaces used openai/gpt-5-mini via provider passthrough.

version_history.note: Initial migration from the notion-worker-email-db-updates Notion Worker.

findPageText: reset the depth budget when descending into a parsed JSON envelope. First live run returned the raw JSON string (escaped \n/\t broke the header parse) because the envelope sits deeper in the runAction result than in the Worker's.

parseMailMetadata moved into a ctx.step: new Date(dateRaw) trips the determinism guard even with an argument. Verified end-to-end against a real Email page — full parity with the Worker, idempotent re-run, 3/3 contacts resolved from the Table with no AI call and no creations.

Inherit Companies/Deals onto the email from each linked contact's Related Company/Deals (merged, never dropped), replacing the native Emails DB automation that doesn't fire on API-driven updates. Waits 90s before inheriting when the run created a contact, so enrich-contact-records can set Related Company first.

Deals inheritance narrowed to OPEN deals only: a candidate deal is fetched and skipped when Status is Closed Won / Closed Lost / Declined (closed set enumerated so future open statuses pass through; unreadable status links with a log). Verified: a contact with a Closed Won deal produced dealsAdded=0.

New contacts are now NAMED, not Primary-Email-only. Two paths, strongest evidence first: (1) parseDisplayNames harvests the mail-block header display name — the block renders 'To: Amandeep Gill \<amandeep@oboxhr.com\>' with markdown-ESCAPED angle brackets, hence the optional backslashes in ADDRESS_WITH_NAME_REGEX; (2) the existing classify-new-emails call gains an 'Email Context' input plus Name / Name Confidence outputs, and only 'high' confidence names are used — for the Gmail plus-reply-chip case where the name is in the body and not the header. Motivation: enrich-contact-records' NinjaPear fallback resolves only on employer_website + a name, so its viability gate skipped a nameless contact outright, leaving it with one enrichment source instead of two. isUsableName rejects mailbox-echo names (support <support@...>) because a WRONG name is worse than none — it is what the enrichment sources match on. extractEmails is untouched, so address extraction cannot regress. Verified: tsc clean; 16 header cases against the real mail block with extractEmails output byte-identical; AI cases identical across two consecutive run-action passes.
